notes.title: New version
notes.content:
[h1]Everlusting Life 5.0.0 is here![/h1]

Hello, Archmage!

This update brings some big improvements to make your adventure smoother and more fun:

[h2]New Main Screen[/h2]

We’ve redesigned the main screen to feel lighter and less cluttered. There’s now a dedicated “Game Modes” button right above “Play” – from there, you can easily choose between different game modes.

[h2]Updated Profile[/h2]

Your profile has a fresh look! You can now see your league right away and customize your avatar. We’ve prepared a whole collection of beautiful avatars – go check them out and pick the one that suits you best! Oh, and don’t lose track: the Settings button has moved to your profile now.

[h2]Inventory System[/h2]

We heard your feedback loud and clear and the inventory is finally here! Now you can track all your resources in one place. You’ll find the new “Inventory” section right in the main menu.

Thank you for your feedback and support – Everlusting Life keeps growing thanks to you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469712/851452d52cdfc87fe7e8e454da78eb9367d15ed2.png[/img]

Picture it: shimmering palaces rising from golden sands, dancers in flowing translucent silks, the heavy scent of incense in the air, and a throne where beauty reigns like a goddess. Here, power is as intoxicating as desire — and both are yours to chase.

But tread carefully: whispers of betrayal echo through every hall, and not all who claim divinity are what they seem…

• A brand-new story chapter set in the Ishtara capital
• The arrival of [b]Cleo[/b], a mysterious Queen
• An [b]interactive BDSM-heavy scene[/b] that pushes boundaries

notes.title: New Game Modes
notes.content:
[h1]Arcanas & Cities[/h1]

We’re excited to introduce two brand-new systems to Everlusting Life — the [b]Arcanas System[/b] and [b]Cities[/b]!

[h2]Arcanas System[/h2]

Arcanas are elegant tattoos for your girls — but they’re not just for looks.
There are six Arcanas in total: [b]Fortune, Priestess, Sorceress, Empress, Justice[/b], and [b]Star[/b]. Each Arcana grants a boost of your girl’s stats.

Once a full Arcana circle is filled, you can level up and continue unlocking even more powerful enhancements to make your girl stronger than ever.

[h2]City[/h2]

Now you have your own City — and it’s waiting for an Archmage to restore order!

Head to the [b]City[/b] section in the main menu to access your buildable cityscape. Each building generates a specific type of [b]Ink[/b], the fuel needed to craft Arcanas.

For example, the [b]Stargazer’s Cottage[/b] produces 10 units of [b]Purple Ink[/b] per hour and stores up to 250. But it can produce and store much more — all you need to do is upgrade it!

To construct and upgrade your buildings, you’ll need Hammers. You can earn them in the [b]Titan Forge[/b] by constructing buildings and collecting Arcanas.

You’ll find the Titan Forge in the Hometown menu — just tap the “Events” icon in the lower-left corner.

Good luck with your building, Archmage!

notes.title: Version 4.0.0 is here!
notes.content:
[h1]Bug fixes and matchmaking system[/h1]

Hello, Archmage!

We’re excited to bring you a new update for EverLusting Life! This version includes several bug fixes as well as improvements to game performance and overall stability.

[h2]League System[/h2]

We’ve listened to community feedback about the matchmaking system. Indeed, the old system was far from perfect, as it matched players based on the total strength of all their maidens. It often resulted in unfair pairings and made your progress feel unrewarding.

To fix this, we’ve reworked the matchmaking system from the ground up. From now on, matchmaking will be based on your League rather than the total strength of your maidens.

We hope this will make matchups much fairer!

Stay tuned for more updates and news!

notes.title: Memories – The Key to Power and Passion
notes.content:
Archmage, prepare for a thrilling new adventure! Your maidens are ready to unveil their most intimate memories, which will not only melt your heart but also make them stronger!

[h2]Unlock the Secrets of the Past[/h2]
Every[b] Friday at 10:00 (UTC)[/b], the Memories section will open on the personal page of one of the maidens. For one week, you’ll have the chance to obtain her Memory—after which it will become unavailable, and the following week, a new maiden will reveal a different Memory.

Memories are unique stories filled with emotions and revelations. To unlock them, you’ll need to embark on a perilous journey. The reward? Enhanced stats for your maidens and unforgettable moments that will stay with you forever!

[h2]Into the Time Rift for Memory Shards[/h2]
Dive into the Time Rift, where Memory Shards are scattered across different timelines. Collect 30 Shards to forge a complete Memory, which will boost your maiden’s abilities. But be warned—the path to these treasures is fraught with challenges!

[h2]Spicy Revelations[/h2]
Each Memory is a story about your maiden’s first orgasm. These moments, brimming with passion and sensuality, are etched forever in their hearts. What was that spark like for the majestic Heliaras? What secrets do the playful Faunias hide? And what mysteries do the mutant Asterias hold?


[i]“‘The first time’ isn’t always a pleasant experience, but the first orgasm is something that truly sticks in your memory, unlocking an incredible range of sensations—and it can happen in… very different situations. We want you to hear their stories firsthand, with maximum candor, spicy details, and, of course, stunning illustrations. Unlock the Memories and build a collection of unforgettable moments!” – Lady, lead writer of Everlusting Life.[/i]

[h2]Ready for the Adventure, Archmage?[/h2]
The maidens eagerly await to share their Memories with you. Don’t delay—the Time Rift opens this Friday at 10:00 UTC. Tomorrow, you'll have a chance to obtain Trish's Memory, and you'll also find Ceres's Memory in the special shop.

Dare to dive in!

notes.title: New Modes, New Pleasures
notes.content:
A fresh patch graces our realm, bringing new modes, powerful upgrades, and intimate features. Here’s what awaits:

[h2]Time-Rift Mode[/h2]
Venture through three enchanted floors filled with PvE battles and arcane trials.
Conquer challenges to earn [b]Memory Shards[/b] via event roulettes and exclusive packs. Seek out [b]Mirrors [/b]— a shimmering resource that unlocks your heroines’ hidden potential.

Time-Rift Mode will only become available after the first Awakening event ends.

[h2]Memories[/h2]
A mysterious new force stirs within your heroines... Memories.
Unlocked on each heroine’s personal page, these arcane echoes enhance unique abilities and provide seductive boosts to stats.
To awaken a Memory, collect [b]50 Memory Shards[/b] — fragments scattered across timelines. These can be found in the all-new Time-Rift mode.
Want to go deeper? Use rare Mirrors to refine Memories, forging stronger bonds and unlocking even greater power.

[h2]Dungeon Mode[/h2]
Descend into the Dungeons, where escalating battles test your might.
Victory brings [b]Regalite[/b]; defeat consumes your precious [b]Life Stones[/b]. Choose your battles wisely.
Discover powerful Artifacts, and exchange your rewards for the coveted Essence of Power — a key to transcend your heroines beyond mortal limits.

Dungeon Mode is available for Wasp-1 League.

Play, explore, and enjoy, Archmage.
May these new modes spark fresh excitement and pleasure on your journey.

notes.title: Ambassador Program
notes.content:
[h1]Everlusting Life Ambassador program
[/h1]

Hello! Today we're glad to announce the start of [b]Everlusting Life Ambassador program[/b]!

It's an open way to share our game with other people on your platform and earn some money out of it!

You fill in a form and get a special referral link, that you can share on your platform. Once a week you'll get payment on the crypto wallet of your choice based on the amount of people who wishlisted the game following your link!   

[h2]What do I need to apply?[/h2]
A platform and audience where you can share the game, and any crypto wallet to get your payment.  

[h2]Where to find the details?[/h2]
If you're interested, check out [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1gEiWye7ND6Ur0ALcWS9A5nVKdu0Id8a0G5y1kE-s-uQ/edit?usp=sharing]this doc[/url], you'll find a [b]link to apply in the end of it[/b]!
